mission.description: The drone leaves its base at (9282, 25091) and has to end up at (-17639, -8610). On the way it must stop at A (Ajman Ruler's Divan Heliport) at (9258, 24320), B (Dubai Safari Park Heliport) at (11046, -2862), C (Schumacher Heliport) at (-21246, 2425), D (SkyDive Dubai Heliport) at (-21671, -12040); visit A before B; visit B before C; visit C before D. Keep it no lower than 40 m and no higher than 80 m. The restricted areas and obstacles (Z1 [Dubai International Airport (OMDB, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z2 [Al Minhad Air Base (OMDM, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m], Z3 [Sharjah International Airport (OMSJ, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m]) are off limits, and that includes cutting across a corner of one on the way between two stops. The whole trip may not be longer than 87351 meters. The battery only allows 91930 energy units, where energy = route length + 30 x total climb (so low altitudes save battery). (START is Ajman Hotel Heliport; DEST is Sheikh Sultan Bin Khalifa bin Zayed Al Nahyan Palace Heliport.) Coordinates are meters east/north of the region center.
